title: Load Balancer Decision Cheat Sheet — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces Load Balancer Selection Decision Traversal: External vs Internal -> Layer 7 vs Layer 4 -> Global vs Regional -> Client IP preservation requirement.
routing_rationale: Decision paths cleanly resolve complex networking scenarios to the exact Google Cloud load balancer SKU.

groups.label: Step 1: Public Internet or Private VPC?

nodes.label: Public External Clients
nodes.detail: Millions of global users connecting from web browsers and mobile apps.

nodes.label: Requires WAF & Edge Caching
nodes.detail: Must protect against DDoS and cache static media assets at edge.

nodes.label: External Application LB (Global)
nodes.detail: Single Anycast VIP delivering Cloud Armor WAF, Cloud CDN, and multi-region routing.

steps.title: Boundary & Feature Filtering
steps.action: Confirms external internet exposure and Layer 7 feature requirements.
steps.why_traversal: Pinpoints External Application Load Balancer with 100% confidence.

scenarios.label: Selected Regional ALB for Multi-Region Workload
scenarios.root_cause: Selected Regional External ALB, preventing cross-region failover between US and Europe.
scenarios.diverted_path: Regional outage took down service globally.
scenarios.recovery: Select Global External ALB when backends span multiple Google Cloud regions.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted

scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
